title: NEST: Nested Embedding Representation for Multiscale Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.30520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world data often exhibits cluster structure at multiple resolutions, yet existing methods typically learn a single partition or construct an explicit hierarchy. Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, we introduce NEST, an unsupervised framework that encodes coarse-to-fine structure within a single embedding. NEST jointly optimizes clustering and separation across nested prefix subspaces, enabling progressively finer distinctions as embedding dimensionality increases, with rank and within-cluster regularization that keep the embedding from collapsing. Empirically, distances in the learned embedding follow the hierarchy distance more closely than those of the input, although the hierarchy is never observed during training. On synthetic hierarchies, NEST recovers multiscale structure given only the number of clusters per level. translated_title: NEST：用于多尺度聚类的嵌套嵌入表示
translated_abstract: 现实世界的数据通常在多个分辨率上呈现出聚类结构，然而现有方法通常只学习单一的划分或构建显式的层次结构。受俄罗斯套娃表示学习的启发，我们提出了NEST，这是一个无监督框架，能够在单一嵌入中编码从粗到细的结构。NEST在嵌套的前缀子空间上联合优化聚类与分离，随着嵌入维度的增加实现逐渐更精细的区分，并通过秩正则化和簇内正则化防止嵌入坍缩。实验表明，尽管层次结构在训练过程中从未被观测到，学习到的嵌入中的距离比输入距离更贴近层次距离。在合成层次数据上，NEST仅需每层的聚类数量即可恢复多尺度结构。在视觉、文本和单细胞数据上的实验进一步证明了多尺度组织的存在。
tldr: 受俄罗斯套娃表示学习启发，NEST提出了一种无监督框架，在单一嵌入中编码从粗到细的多尺度聚类结构，无需在训练中观测层次信息即可恢复数据的多尺度聚类组织。
en_tdlr: Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, NEST is an unsupervised framework that encodes coarse-to-fine multiscale cluster structure within a single embedding, recovering hierarchical organization without ever observing the hierarchy during training.
